deep_dive.title: Beyond Magnitude: Contrastive Routing for Modular Mixture-of-Experts
deep_dive.abstract: In current Mixture-of-Experts architectures, routing is performed based on representations dominated by structure shared across all tokens, limiting expert specialization. We show that contrasting each token against an Exponential Moving Average of the layer's hidden states, rather than routing on absolute magnitude, concentrates the routing signal onto a low-dimensional, highly separable subspace. Building on this, we propose the Contrastive Routing Mechanism (CoRM), which scores each expert by the gap between its affinity for the incoming token and its affinity for this shared reference state, interpreted through a distinct per-expert projection. The resulting experts have routing boundaries that align with linguistic structure significantly more than the Top-k baseline. Our experiments show that CoRM improves average zero-shot accuracy by +0.67 to +1.69 points (Top-1) and +1.38 to +1.77 points (Top-2) over standard Top-k MoE baselines on nine zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, at the minimal cost of 2.9% added parameters and 2.6% added FLOPs per token.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: Explicitly targets expert specialization in MoE by replacing magnitude routing with a contrastive routing mechanism.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_cn: 直接指出绝对幅值路由限制专家专业化，并提出对比路由CoRM加以改善。

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: CoRM replaces magnitude-based routing in MoE by contrasting each token with an EMA reference state, producing separable routing signals that make expert boundaries align with linguistic structure and improve specialization.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 当前混合专家以绝对表示幅度进行路由，表示中占主导的共享结构会压制专家专业化。本文证明将每个token与层隐状态的指数滑动平均进行对比，可把路由信号集中到低维且高度可分的子空间。据此提出的对比路由机制CoRM用token与共享参考态对各专家的亲和力差距打分，并配合每专家独立投影来解释路由。结果表明专家路由边界与语言结构的对齐程度显著提高，为增强MoE专家分工提供了直接有效的路由设计。

deep_dive.title: PCoMoE: Shifting MoE Inference from Monolithic Expert Selection to Fine-Grained Path Composition
deep_dive.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale Large Language Model (LLM) capacity efficiently by activating a sparse subset of experts per token. However, modern MoE inference remains heavily constrained by the rigid, whole-expert abstraction. Existing frameworks manage, schedule, or prune experts as atomic execution units, which fixes the optimization boundary too early and leaves fine-grained intra-expert computational redundancy underexplored. In this work, we present PCoMoE, a path-compositional execution framework that shifts MoE inference from coarse-grained expert selection to fine-grained path composition. PCoMoE incorporates a path-level formulation of expert computation, a compatibility-aware layer-wise pruning strategy to suppress low-value path combinations, and a hardware-friendly execution engine to exploit reusable sub-expert structures under strictly bounded overheads. Experimental results demonstrate that PCoMoE achieves up to a 1.31x end-to-end inference speedup while enhancing model accuracy by 10%. The code is available at https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: MoE推理长期把专家当作原子执行单元，导致专家内部计算冗余未被利用。本文提出PCoMoE路径组合执行框架，将优化边界从整体专家下推到细粒度计算路径，并设计路径级专家计算形式与兼容感知的分层剪枝策略。该框架按路径进行推理调度，无需将专家视为单一整体。实验表明其在保持精度的同时有效降低推理开销，突破原子专家选择的瓶颈。该工作为MoE高效部署和更灵活的专家路由机制提供了新的设计空间。

quick_skim.title: Residual Sparsification via Output Importance for Compressing Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
quick_skim.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models efficiently, but they demand massive GPU memory. To cope with such demand, models are commonly compressed to reduce their memory footprint. Residual sparsification is a representative compression technique that decomposes each projection matrix of an expert into a shared base matrix and per-expert residual matrix, and then compresses the residuals. Existing sparsification methods compress each residual matrix independently by minimizing its compression error, thereby minimizing the error of each projection matrix. However, our analysis shows that this objective is misaligned with preserving model accuracy after compression. In an expert, the final output is produced through computations coupled across multiple projections and hidden representations. Therefore, even small errors in individual matrices can propagate through hidden representations and projection interactions, leading to large expert output errors and accuracy degradation. To address this misalignment, we propose PARSER, a new residual sparsification method that shifts the compression objective from minimizing isolated matrix errors to preserving the expert output error. PARSER achieves this by introducing output importance, which measures the actual contribution to the expert output error. Our experiments show that, compared with existing methods, PARSER narrows the accuracy gap to the uncompressed model by 1.41$\times$ on Qwen and 1.44$\times$ on DeepSeek, while achieving the same peak memory reduction.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Compresses Mixture-of-Experts LLMs by sparsifying per-expert residual matrices according to output importance

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes an output-importance-aware residual sparsification method for compressing MoE LLMs; it shows that compressing each expert residual independently by minimizing per-matrix error conflicts with preserving model accuracy because expert outputs are aggregated, and thus uses output importance to guide residual sparsification.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: Mixture-of-Experts大语言模型在扩展参数规模时占用大量GPU显存，常用残差稀疏化将每个专家的投影矩阵分解为共享基矩阵与专家残差矩阵再压缩。作者发现逐专家最小化压缩误差并不能有效保持压缩后精度，因为专家输出还需经聚合产生最终结果。为此提出按输出重要性引导残差稀疏化的压缩方法，使稀疏化预算与模型精度目标对齐。该方法为MoE大模型压缩提供了更合理的残差稀疏化准则。
